description: Phase 14: 3x3 spatial reasoning. Fixture has a 3x3 grid (rows + cols labelled 1-3) with a single red star at row 2 / column 2 (middle). The prompt asks which row contains the star.

image_fixture.license: Luak-owned synthetic; no real PII; generated by scripts/generate-vision-fixtures.py (phase14 v1)
image_fixture.notes: Synthetic 3x3 grid with row/col labels 1-3. Star at (row=2, col=2).

questions.question: The grid is labelled with rows 1-3 (top to bottom) and columns 1-3 (left to right). Which row contains the star? Reply with the row number or the word.

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for row identification in labelled grid. Pass requires explicit reference to row 2 / middle row.

known_scoring_limitations: Pass-phrase ' 2' (leading space) accepts answers like 'The star is at 2' but also any answer containing a standalone '2' surrounded by whitespace. 80-char max_chars limits the chance of accidental matches in longer prose.
